strikes.name: hook
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): A flat, tight arc at head height, the elbow a sharp right angle, the plated forearm leading the hand.
strikes.orig: a wide round swing of the open hand at head height, the arm one long curve, the other open hand up at his cheek and the body turning full behind it

strikes.name: overhand
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): A looping blow over the rival's guard, the shoulder rolled high, the head ducked off the line.
strikes.orig: the open hand wheeled up and over in a big circle, the arm long, the body rising behind it, the head up and the eyes on the target

strikes.name: haymaker
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): The widest swing he has: the arm nearly straight, the whole torso thrown round behind it.
strikes.orig: a wheeling open-handed swing from low behind to the side, the arm nearly straight, the free hand flung back the other way for the turn

strikes.name: palm_heel
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): A clawed open palm pushed straight in from the ribs, fingers spread like tines, the wrist bent back.
strikes.orig: a quick flat open palm pushed in at chest height with a step, the fingers together and up, the other hand open at his own chest

strikes.name: spear_hand
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): A low blade-hand thrust from the crouch into the gut, the spine and the arm one long diagonal.
strikes.orig: a straight flat hand thrust low into the belly from a stand, the knees bent a little, the body upright and leaning in

strikes.name: twin_spear
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): Both blade hands thrust side by side, a hand apart, elbows locked: two parallel lines.
strikes.orig: both open hands thrust together, one high and one low, a hand and a half apart: a staggered pair, never two parallel lines

strikes.name: double_palm
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): Both clawed palms shoved in at shoulder width, fingers up, elbows flared wide.
strikes.orig: both flat palms shoved in at shoulder width with the elbows in and the fingers up, the body behind them: a blow, with nothing held out after it

strikes.name: cross_arm_ram
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): The forearm guards crossed into a wedge and driven in behind the shoulders, head tucked behind the plates.
strikes.orig: both forearms side by side like a bar, one a little higher, driven in behind the shoulder: a ram, never a wedge of crossed arms

strikes.name: snap_round
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): A quick whip from the knee, the hips barely turned, the foot back before the rival moves.
strikes.orig: a quick round whip of the leg from the knee, the hands up and open at his face, the standing leg springing

strikes.name: roundhouse
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): The full turn of the hips, the leg a long blade through the ribs, the arms thrown back the other way.
strikes.orig: the full round swing of a straight leg through the ribs, the turn of the hips round and the hands kept up and open, not thrown back

strikes.name: spinning_heel
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): One turn with his back shown, the heel coming round at the end of a straight leg.
strikes.orig: one round turn with the arms opened wide to carry it, the heel coming round at the end of a long leg, the head turned to keep the eyes on him

strikes.name: sweep
strikes.look: His version (open hands, rounder): Dropped onto one hand, the other leg scything flat along the ground.
strikes.orig: a wide low arc: down on one open hand, the other arm lifted for balance, the leg swept round flat along the ground

strikes.name: palm_push
strikes.look: One open hand driven from the shoulder into the chest, the other hand open at his own chest.
strikes.orig: one open hand driven from the shoulder into the chest, the other hand open at his own chest, the weight shifting through the palm

strikes.name: ridge_hand
strikes.look: The edge of the open hand swung round in an arc to the head.
strikes.orig: the edge of the open hand swung round in an arc to the head, the elbow leading and then opening, the other hand at his chest

strikes.name: rising_palm
strikes.look: The heel of an open hand lifted under the jaw, the body rising behind it.
strikes.orig: the heel of the open hand lifted under the jaw, the body rising behind it on straight legs with the feet staying down, the arm lowering at once

strikes.name: knife_chop
strikes.look: A short downward chop with a flat hand to the shoulder, the elbow bent through it.
strikes.orig: a short downward chop with a flat hand to the shoulder, the elbow staying bent through it, the other hand open at his chest

strikes.name: hammer_fist
strikes.look: The bottom of one fist brought down in a short blow: the return blow that sends down.
strikes.orig: one fist brought down on its heel in a short return blow, the other hand open at his chest; nothing held up after it

strikes.name: crescent_kick
strikes.look: A straight leg swept round from the inside out at chest height, the hands up and open.
strikes.orig: a straight leg swept round from the inside out in a crescent at chest height, the hands up and open

strikes.name: hook_kick
strikes.look: The leg carried past the target and the heel hooked back round into the chest.
strikes.orig: the leg carried past the target and the heel hooked back round into the chest, the knee folding, the hands up and open

strikes.name: spinning_back_kick
strikes.look: One turn with his back shown and a straight kick with the heel into the belly.
strikes.orig: one turn with his back shown and a straight kick with the heel into the belly, the arms open for the turn

strikes.name: jab
strikes.look: A straight blade hand from the lead shoulder, the arm one line with the rear leg; the body barely turns.
strikes.orig: a straight blade hand from the lead shoulder, the arm one line with the rear leg, the body barely turning

strikes.name: cross
strikes.look: The rear hand driven straight through the chest, hips turned full, the lead forearm guard folded across the ribs.
strikes.orig: the rear blade hand driven through the chest with the hips turned full, the lead forearm folded across the ribs

strikes.name: backfist
strikes.look: The arm unfolds backhanded to full length, the back of the hand leading, chest opened away from the rival.
strikes.orig: the arm unfolding backhanded to full length, the back of the hand leading, the chest opened away from the rival

strikes.name: uppercut
strikes.look: A closed fist rising under the chin; the rise is in the hip and shoulder, the feet stay where they are, the other arm low across the body.
strikes.orig: a closed fist rising under the chin, the rise in the hip and shoulder, the feet planted, the other arm low across the body

strikes.name: hammer
strikes.look: The fist comes straight down from above the head like a dropped blade, the body folding over it.
strikes.orig: the fist brought straight down from above the head like a dropped blade, the body folding over it

strikes.name: short_elbow
strikes.look: The forearm folded shut and the point of the elbow cut across under the jaw: a small, sharp triangle.
strikes.orig: the forearm folded shut and the point of the elbow cut across at face height: a small sharp triangle

strikes.name: rising_elbow
strikes.look: The elbow driven up the centre line under the jaw, the hand ending behind his own ear, the plate edge leading.
strikes.orig: the elbow driven up the centre line, the hand ending behind his own ear, the plate edge leading

strikes.name: spinning_elbow
strikes.look: One turn with his back shown, the elbow whipping through level at jaw height at the end of it.
strikes.orig: one turn with his back shown, the elbow whipping through level at the end of it

strikes.name: dropping_elbow
strikes.look: From above: the point of the elbow dropped onto the chest, the other hand pinning the rival's guard down.
strikes.orig: the point of the elbow dropped onto the chest from above, the other hand pinning the rival guard down

strikes.name: double_hammer
strikes.look: Both forearm guards brought down side by side like a dropped bar; the hands are apart and open.
strikes.orig: both forearm guards brought down side by side like a dropped bar, the hands apart and open

strikes.name: front_kick
strikes.look: A straight push with the ball of the foot from a high knee, the body leaning back off the line.
strikes.orig: a straight push with the ball of the foot from a high knee, the body leaning back off the line

strikes.name: side_kick
strikes.look: Turned fully side-on, the leg and the opposite arm one horizontal line, the heel leading.
strikes.orig: turned fully side-on, the leg and the opposite arm one horizontal line, the heel leading

strikes.name: low_kick
strikes.look: A short chop of the shin into the thigh, his own body upright and still.
strikes.orig: a short chop of the shin into the thigh, his own body upright and still

strikes.name: axe_kick
strikes.look: The leg lifted straight and brought down heel first onto the collar, his body a vertical line beside it.
strikes.orig: the leg lifted straight and brought down heel first onto the collar, his body a vertical line beside it

strikes.name: stomp
strikes.look: The knee drawn to his chest and the sole driven straight down; his arms spread for balance.
strikes.orig: the knee drawn to his chest and the sole driven straight down, his arms spread for balance

strikes.name: drop_kick
strikes.look: Both feet together with the body laid flat behind them, arms back along his sides.
strikes.orig: both feet together with the body laid flat behind them, the arms back along his sides

strikes.name: short_knee
strikes.look: A short knee from the clinch, one hand on the rival's shoulder, the standing leg straight.
strikes.orig: a short knee from the clinch, one hand on the rival shoulder, the standing leg straight

strikes.name: rising_knee
strikes.look: The knee driven up as he rises onto the toes, hips thrust through, both hands pulling down.
strikes.orig: the knee driven up as he rises onto the toes, the hips thrust through, both hands pulling down

strikes.name: driving_knee
strikes.look: A knee carried in on the end of a run, the body leaning back, the trailing leg straight behind.
strikes.orig: a knee carried in on the end of a run, the body leaning back, the trailing leg straight behind

strikes.name: headbutt
strikes.look: The masked brow driven into the jaw from the waist, hands holding the rival's arms down.
strikes.orig: the masked brow snapped forward from the neck and waist, the hands holding the rival arms down

strikes.name: shoulder_check
strikes.look: A short step and the plated shoulder into the chest, chin tucked behind it, arms close.
strikes.orig: a short step and the plated shoulder into the chest, the chin tucked behind it, the arms close

strikes.name: body_ram
strikes.look: Redesigned: a short step and the plated shoulder driven into the chest, the chin tucked behind it, the forearm guards close.
strikes.orig: a short step and the plated shoulder driven into the chest, the chin tucked behind it, the forearm guards close against the ribs: shoulder first
